### Service 1 — Ceramic Coating
Type: Service / Offer
Name: Ceramic Coating Warrington
URL: https://warringtoncardetailing.co.uk/ceramic-coating
Category: Paint Protection
Description: Professional ceramic coating service that chemically bonds to vehicle paintwork creating a permanent hydrophobic, UV-resistant protective layer. Lasts 3–7 years. Suitable for all vehicle types including luxury and prestige cars.
Process: Decontamination wash → clay bar treatment → machine polishing → ceramic coating application → cure
Price: From £350 GBP
Duration: 1–2 full days
Brands/products used: Professional-grade SiO2 ceramic coatings
Benefits:
  - Hydrophobic surface — water, mud and dirt bead off
  - UV protection — prevents paint fade and oxidation
  - Chemical resistance — bird droppings, road salt, tar, tree sap
  - Deep gloss enhancement
  - Long-term protection (years, not months)
Target vehicles: All cars including BMW, Mercedes, Audi, Porsche, Land Rover, Range Rover

Type: Service / Offer

Alternate name: Paint Correction Warrington
URL: https://warringtoncardetailing.co.uk/paint-correction
Category: Paint Correction / Paint Enhancement
Description: Professional multi-stage machine polishing service that permanently removes swirl marks, fine scratches, water spots, bird dropping etching and oxidation from vehicle paintwork. Uses dual-action and rotary polishers with professional compounds matched to paint condition.
Process: Paint inspection under specialist lighting → wash & iron fallout decontamination → stage machine polish (cutting → polishing → finishing) → paint sealant or ceramic coating

Duration: 4–8 hours (Stage 1); Full day (Stage 2)
Stages available: Stage 1 (single stage polish), Stage 2 (multi-stage correction)

  - Permanently removes swirl marks and fine scratches
  - Eliminates water spot etching and oxidation
  - Restores paint clarity and depth
  - Safe on all paint types including soft European and Japanese finishes
  - Results visible immediately

## FAQ ENTITIES
Type: FAQPage / Question / Answer

Q: What are your main services?
A: Our two primary services are ceramic coating (from £350) and machine polishing (from £200). We also offer full car detailing, interior detailing, and headlight restoration.

Q: Is ceramic coating worth it?
A: Yes. Ceramic coating is the most advanced paint protection available. It bonds chemically to your paintwork and lasts 3–7 years, protecting against UV, bird droppings, road salt, and water. For anyone who values their vehicle's appearance, it is the best investment available.

Q: What is machine polishing?
A: Machine polishing (also called paint correction) uses professional rotary and dual-action polishing machines with abrasive compounds to permanently remove swirl marks, fine scratches, water spots and oxidation from paintwork. It is the only way to truly correct paint defects — not cover them.

Q: Do I need machine polishing before ceramic coating?
A: Yes — if your paint has swirl marks or scratches, machine polishing should always be done before ceramic coating. Ceramic coating will lock in any defects permanently. Our combined machine polish + ceramic coating package is our most popular service.

Q: Where are you based?
A: We are based at Unit 1 Fairclough Mill, Atherton's Quay, Warrington, WA5 1AH. All services are carried out at our dedicated detailing unit — customers bring their vehicles to us.

Q: How much does ceramic coating cost in Warrington?
A: Ceramic coating starts from £350 at Car Ceramic Coating and detailing warrington0. The exact price depends on vehicle size and paint condition. We always provide a free, fixed-price quote before any work begins.

Q: How much does machine polishing cost in Warrington?
A: Machine polishing (paint correction) starts from £200 for a Stage 1 single-stage polish and from £350 for a multi-stage correction. Contact us for a free quote tailored to your vehicle and its specific paint condition.

Q: Are you open on weekends?
A: Yes — Car Ceramic Coating and detailing warrington0 is open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including weekends and bank holidays. Call 07958 752513 or WhatsApp us any time.
